question: Aminoglycoside affects ?

options.opa: Outer hair cells in basal area
options.opb: Inner hair cells in basal area
options.opc: Outer hair cells in apical area

CHAIN: "Aminoglycosides disrupt protein synthesis" -> "lead to cell death in sensory cells" -> "more pronounced in basal area" -> "affects outer hair cells" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Aminoglycosides preferentially target rapidly dividing cells" -> "inner hair cells are more susceptible" -> "damage occurs in basal area" -> "affects inner hair cells" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Aminoglycosides have a dose-dependent effect" -> "higher concentrations lead to more damage" -> "outer hair cells in basal area are affected" -> "possible damage to inner hair cells" -> 75%
analysis: Aminoglycosides are known to primarily affect the inner hair cells in the basal area of the cochlea, leading to sensorineural hearing loss. They can also impact outer hair cells, but the inner hair cells are more significantly affected in terms of auditory function.
